recent_articles.title: Naidu to inaugurate MSME Growth Summit-2026 in Vijayawada on May 25 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** will inaugurate the **MSME Growth Summit-2026** in Vijayawada on Monday, May 25th. The event, a flagship initiative of the **Andhra Pradesh government**, aims to accelerate the growth and competitiveness of micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) across the state.  The summit will feature over 1,500 stakeholders, including entrepreneurs, industry associations, policymakers, financial institutions, and technology partners. It will showcase innovation ecosystems, infrastructure initiatives, digital transformation programs, and success stories of MSMEs from Andhra Pradesh. The summit will also launch key initiatives like the foundation stone laying for Phase III of MSME Parks, the AP Cluster Development Programme, and the SIDBI-RTIH Seed Fund.

recent_articles.title: A.P. continues to grapple with intense heat as 95 mandals record above 42°C - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** continues to experience intense heat, with 95 out of 688 mandals recording temperatures above 42°C.  The highest temperature reached 45.8°C at Kanumolu in Krishna district. While some districts received light to moderate rainfall on Saturday, severe heatwave conditions are expected for 21 mandals and widespread heatwave conditions for 214 mandals on Sunday. The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** predicts that weather systems brewing over the Bay of Bengal may bring isolated showers with lightning and thunderstorms in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Rayalaseema next week, but this activity is not expected to be widespread.

recent_articles.title: Cricket betting racket busted, four arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chilakalapudi police** arrested four individuals in connection with an online betting operation on IPL cricket matches.  The suspects, P. Dharani Kumar, P. Ravi Kumar, Ch. Ravindra Kumar and I. Satyam, were apprehended during a raid at Edepalli on Friday night. The **Krishna district SP**, V. Vidyasagar Naidu, confirmed the seizure of ₹36,000 in cash and eight mobile phones from the suspects' possession.

recent_articles.title: Chennai and surrounding areas to experience cloudy weather - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chennai** experienced cloudy skies on Saturday due to a low-level circulation over the central Bay of Bengal and a north–south trough. **V.R. Durai**, Director, Regional Weather Forecasting Centre, explained that this interaction caused enhanced moisture incursion and strong onshore winds, leading to widespread low and mid-level clouds. Residents reported a sandstorm at Marina Beach, while Sunday is expected to be cloudy with heavy rain possible in isolated areas of Tamil Nadu and surrounding regions.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet clears 2.5 lakh houses, ₹587 crore for PRLSI - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana** Cabinet approved a range of initiatives, including the launch of the second phase of Indiramma houses and funding for the Palamuru-Rangareddy Lift Irrigation Scheme.  **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** announced plans to complete unfinished Indiramma houses and allocate funds for their completion. The Cabinet also allocated ₹1,000 crore for the upcoming Godavari Pushkarams and the mid-day meal scheme in all junior colleges. Additionally, **Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy**, Minister for Revenue and Housing, stated that the government will provide financial assistance to complete unfinished Indiramma houses and will allocate funds for construction of one lakh low-income group (LIG) houses in 24 Assembly constituencies.

recent_articles.title: Deepa Jewellers, Cotec Healthcare receive Sebi approval for IPOs - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Deepa Jewellers**, a Hyderabad-based company specializing in hallmarked gold jewelry processing and trading, plans to raise funds through an IPO consisting of a fresh issue and offer-for-sale. The IPO will include up to Rs 250 crore worth of shares from the company and up to 1.18 crore shares offered for sale by promoters **Ashish Agarwal** and **Seema Agarwal**.  **Cotec Healthcare**, a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) serving pharmaceutical companies, also received Sebi approval for its IPO. The company manufactures formulations across various therapeutic segments and operates a manufacturing facility in Roorkee with an installed capacity of over 4 billion units.

recent_articles.title: APPCB holds public hearing on proposed water aerodrome project - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board (APPCB)** hosted a public hearing on Thursday regarding the proposed Water Aerodrome Project in Prakasam Barrage by **Andhra Pradesh Airports Development Corporation Limited (APADCL)**.  The hearing was presided over by **NTR District Collector Dr. G. Lakshmisha**, with representatives from various organizations participating. The Human Rights Forum (HRF) strongly opposed the project, demanding the cancellation of the Draft Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) Report due to errors.

recent_articles.title: New govt. hospital, preventing waterlogging are among my priorities, says Katpadi MLA - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M. Sudhakar**, Katpadi MLA, has identified traffic congestion between the railway station and Green Circle roundabout as a top priority for his constituency. He proposes diverting trucks and goods lorries from Andhra Pradesh to reach Ranipet and Kancheepuram via Chittoor limits, aiming to alleviate the heavy traffic flow during rush hour on Old Katpadi Road.  He plans to present this proposal to the **State government**.

recent_articles.title: IT-based skill training launched for inmates at Visakhapatnam Central Jail - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** Prisons Department and the **Skill Development Institute (SDI)**, Visakhapatnam, launched an IT-based skill development course for inmates at the Visakhapatnam Central Jail. The "Office Assistant" program, inaugurated by **Visakhapatnam District Collector M. Abhishikth Kishore**, aims to equip inmates with industry-oriented skills and improve their employability prospects after release.  The two-month course covers computer applications, office administration, digital communication, and employability skills, with successful participants receiving a certification from SDI Visakhapatnam.

recent_articles.title: SIR in Telangana: Draft electoral rolls to have names of electors whose Enumeration Forms are received - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Electoral Registration Officers (ERO)** in **Telangana** will publish draft electoral rolls on July 31, 2026, including names of all electors whose Enumeration Forms were received.  Following this, EROs will issue notices to individuals who cannot be linked or have discrepancies in their linking with the previous revision's electoral rolls. This is part of a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) conducted for the first time since 2002 when **Telangana** was part of united Andhra Pradesh.

recent_articles.title: Telangana Congress raises concerns over SIR process - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC)** met **Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy** on May 15, 2026, to express concerns and suggest improvements for the proposed Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The party urged a phased and carefully planned revision process over one-and-a-half to two years, citing concerns about the scale of the exercise and the lack of major elections scheduled in the near future.  They also requested specific measures like providing voter lists from 2002 and 2025, extending objection periods, ensuring physical notice before deletion, conducting proper field verification, and addressing allegations of irregularities in the pre-SIR mapping process. The Congress party also demanded safeguards for migrant voters and special awareness programs for weaker sections.

recent_articles.title: Security stepped up for visit of Chandrababu Naidu, Rajnath Singh to Puttaparthi on May 15 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** and **Union Minister for Defence Rajnath Singh** are scheduled to visit Puttaparthi on May 15th to lay the foundation stone for a ₹1 lakh crore fifth-generation fighter aircraft manufacturing project.  The project will span 650 acres and is expected to create significant employment opportunities in the region.  **District Collector A. Shyam Prasad** oversaw security arrangements, including electricity, medical, and fire services on standby at the venue. **Superintendent of Police S. Satish Kumar** reviewed security measures for both the event and **Lokesh’s** visit to Battalapalli on May 14th.

recent_articles.title: Govt. revives annual journalism awards in Andhra Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh**'s government has established a four-member committee to select and present awards for outstanding journalists in recognition of excellence. The awards, including a Lifetime Achievement Award with ₹3 lakh prize money, will be presented in July.  The committee is led by **Alapati Suresh Kumar**, Chairman of the C.R. Media Academy, and includes former India Today Editor A.A.V. Prasad, Andhra Kesari University Vice-Chancellor D.V.R. Murthy, and retired High Court judge Satyanarayana Murthy.

recent_articles.title: SC asks Centre to consider States’ pleas for funds for CCTVs in police stations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** urged the **Union government** to fully implement the Assistance to States and Union Territories for Modernisation of Police (ASUMP) scheme, which provides funds for installing CCTV cameras in police stations and a centralized monitoring dashboard. The court expressed concerns over non-functional CCTV cameras in Udaipur police stations and directed the Centre to consider requests from states for funding.  The ASUMP scheme has been extended until September 30, 2026, with most states initiating steps towards compliance. However, Jharkhand was criticized for not installing any CCTV cameras, despite receiving funds under the scheme. The court also cautioned against releasing funds without due diligence to prevent misappropriation.

recent_articles.title: West Godavari district of A.P. bets big on green silica industry - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **West Godavari district**, in Andhra Pradesh, is transforming its agricultural waste into a valuable resource through the processing of rice husk.  The byproduct, previously discarded or burned, is now being converted into high-value industrial materials like silica gel and precipitated silica. This shift is driven by rising demand for these products in sectors such as the automotive industry, electronics, and food production. The **Andhra Pradesh** government has supported this initiative through policies offering financial incentives to encourage rice millers to diversify their operations.  The district's efforts aim to create a zero-waste industrial hub and boost rural economic growth.

recent_articles.title: Green energy key to India’s future growth: Naidu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Narendra Modi** urged citizens to reduce edible oil consumption and increase public transport usage, while **N. Chandrababu Naidu**, Andhra Pradesh's Chief Minister, emphasized India's need for energy security and sustainable development through green energy and decentralized power systems.  Naidu spoke at the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Business Summit in New Delhi on Monday, highlighting India's growing economic power under **Modi's** leadership.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: Will hear Trinamool pleas on victory margins being less than deleted votes in SIR, says Supreme Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, leader of the **Trinamool Congress**, appeared before the Supreme Court on Monday, May 11, 2026, to argue that deletions made during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in West Bengal affected election results.  Senior advocate Kalyan Bandhopadhyay argued that in some seats, the BJP's victory margin was less than the number of votes deleted. The court asked for an application from **Banerjee** to address the issue and promised to seek information about pending appeals from the Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court. The Supreme Court also gave the National Investigation Agency two months to complete its probe into the case of seven judicial officers who were gheraoed in Malda on April 1.

recent_articles.title: Sexual assault case: child rights commission visits victim in Eluru - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh State Commission for Protection of Child Rights (APSCPCR)** chairperson Vetukuri A.V.S. Suryanarayana Raju and member V. Gandhi Babu visited a minor girl who was allegedly sexually abused by a pastor on Monday, May 11, 2026. They inquired with doctors about the girl's condition and assured the family of government support and protection.  **Women Development and Child Welfare Department Joint Director Sujatha Rani**, **Eluru District Project Director Sarada**, **District Child Protection Officer Ch. Surya Chakraveni**, and other officials accompanied the Commission.

recent_articles.title: Did BJP internal wranglings upset Modi? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** visit to Telangana was met with disappointment among **BJP** leaders, who expressed dissatisfaction over internal disagreements and factional politics.  Sources claim the PM was particularly upset by his time spent with Andhra Pradesh CM **Chandrababu Naidu** and Deputy CM **Pawan Kalyan**, which they believe unnerved party members.

recent_articles.title: Farmers take out rally demanding legal guarantee for MSP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Scores** of farmers from across **Andhra Pradesh**, **Assam**, and other states participated in a rally organized by the **Akhila Bharata Aikya Rythu Sangham (AIUKS)** in Yellandu, Bhadradri Kothagudem district. The rally demanded a legal guarantee for Minimum Support Price (MSP) and implementation of the C2 + 50% formula.  **AIUKS** leaders, including **Pradeep Singh Tagore**, **Kechela Ranga Reddy**, and **Potu Ranga Rao**, led the demonstration, which culminated in a public meeting.

recent_articles.title: Summit highlights urgency of aligning education with future job markets - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Apollo University**, **Chittoor** and the **University of Leicester** jointly hosted the second edition of the Apollo-Leicester Education Summit-2026 in Vijayawada. The summit brought together diplomats, academic leaders, and industry experts from both countries to discuss how students can prepare for careers in 2030 and beyond.  **Daniel Ladley**, Pro Vice-Chancellor of the **University of Leicester School of Business**, emphasized the importance of globally relevant, employability-focused education. **Gareth Wynn Owen**, British Deputy High Commissioner for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, highlighted the growing collaboration between India and the UK in education, innovation, and careers.

recent_articles.title: Govt. to bring reforms in AYUSH sector to enhance quality: Health Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The State government of Andhra Pradesh** is implementing reforms in the AYUSH sector to enhance healthcare services and combat the distribution of fake drugs. **Minister for Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Satya Kumar Yadav** announced the establishment of three committees – an expert committee, a stakeholders committee, and a technical committee – to develop new guidelines. The committees will consult experts, gather public feedback, and study best practices from other states like Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu before submitting their recommendations.  The aim is to strengthen the regulatory framework for AYUSH clinics and hospitals, ensuring all practitioners are qualified and services meet national standards.

recent_articles.title: Andhra GST officials urged to support tech-driven tax reforms - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chowdary Purushottam Naidu**, president of the **Andhra Pradesh GST Officers and Employees Association**, urged officials to support tax reforms and technology usage, criticizing those who oppose them.  He claimed that a few officials are hindering the government's efforts by creating unrest over promotions denied due to procedural issues. **Babu Ahmed**, Chief Commissioner of the AP GST wing, has been praised for his role in maximizing tax collections through technology. The **APNGOs Association** pledged support for effective tax collection while refraining from interfering with government policies regarding transfers and other matters.

recent_articles.title: PIL in SC for reviewing wages of priests, sevadars and temple staff in govt.-controlled temples - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An advocate, **Ashwini Upadhyay**, has filed a plea in the Supreme Court seeking direction for the Centre and State governments to establish a judicial commission or expert committee to review wages and benefits provided to priests, sevadars, and temple staff in state-controlled temples. The petition argues that these individuals are employees under the Code on Wages, 2019, and that denying them dignified wages violates their right to livelihood guaranteed by Article 21 of the Constitution.  **Upadhyay** cites instances of protests in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana demanding minimum wages for priests and temple staff who are not receiving even the minimum wage prescribed by the State. The plea also highlights a circular issued by a Tamil Nadu department prohibiting priests from accepting 'Dakshina' in 'aarti plates', further highlighting the precarious nature of their livelihood.

recent_articles.title: A.P. EAPCET-2026 to begin from May 12 across A.P. and Telangana - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)** has completed preparations for the A.P. EAPCET-2026, a common entrance test for engineering, agriculture, and pharmacy programs, scheduled for May 12-20 in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.  **B. Tirupati Rao**, Council Secretary, announced that over 355,000 candidates applied online this year. The exam will be computer-based with two sessions: 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., overseen by **Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU)-Kakinada** and chaired by **N. Mohan Rao**.

recent_articles.title: From flight journey to land gifts, SSC toppers receive unique rewards in A.P. - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Students** in Andhra Pradesh are being recognized for their academic achievement in the SSC Public Examinations-2026.  In Vizianagaram district, **A. Hemanth**, the school topper with 581 marks, was given a flight experience from Visakhapatnam to Vijayawada by his lab assistant, **Miriyala Krishna Rao**. The gesture aims to provide students with both academic success and memorable life experiences.

recent_articles.title: Modi visits Naidu, Pawan in Hyderabad - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** visited **Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** and **Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan** at their residences in Hyderabad on Sunday.  **Naidu** expressed gratitude to **Modi** for his support of Andhra Pradesh's development, while **Pawan Kalyan** noted the Prime Minister's personal concern for his health.

recent_articles.title: CITU calls South Coast Railway zone a “betrayal” of Andhra Pradesh, flags revenue loss - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Centre’s** notification operationalising the South Coast Railway (SCoR) zone from June 1, 2026, has drawn criticism from **the Centre of Indian Trade Unions (CITU)**.  **CITU** leaders argue that the new zone weakens Andhra Pradesh's interests by retaining key revenue-generating railway sections under the East Coast Railway (ECoR), and accuses the Union government of diverting railway revenue to Odisha. They also raised concerns over territorial jurisdiction, recruitment freezes, and privatization efforts, calling for a zone that serves the economic interests of Andhra Pradesh.

recent_articles.title: Grant EL to teachers handling SSC remedial classes: FAPTO - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **FAPTO** members have requested the **School Education Department** to grant Earned Leave (EL) to teachers conducting special and remedial classes for SSC failed students during the summer vacation. The request was made in a representation submitted to Director of School Education Thameem Ansariya, who issued orders for these classes following the 2026 SSC exams.

recent_articles.title: Mortality of neem trees goes up in A.P.; scientists blame fungus, insect attack - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. Y.S.R. Horticulture University (Dr.YSRHU)** scientists in Andhra Pradesh are investigating reports of increased neem tree mortality across the state.  The research team found that the trees are dying due to a fungus called Phomopsis Azadirachtae and the Tea Mosquito Bug, which causes damage to leaves, twigs, inflorescence, and fruits. **Dr. YSRHU** Vice-Chancellor K. Dhanumjaya Rao advised pruning affected branches and applying fungicide and insecticide to control the infection.  He also urged residents to report any neem tree issues to local horticulture colleges and research stations.

recent_articles.title: BC hostels emerge as top-performing welfare hostels in Andhra Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Backward Classes Welfare Hostels in Andhra Pradesh** have achieved the highest satisfaction rate among welfare hostels, according to a parent feedback survey conducted by the government. The Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS) revealed a 78.20% satisfaction rate for these hostels, surpassing other categories. **S. Savitha**, the BC Welfare Minister, attributes this improvement to the government's focus on strengthening educational support, infrastructure, nutrition, and student welfare.

recent_articles.title: Naidu and Pawan congratulate Suvendu Adhikari on taking oath as West Bengal CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. Chandrababu Naidu**, **Prime Narendra Modi**, and **K. Pawan Kalyan**  attended the swearing-in ceremony of **Suvendu Adhikari** as Chief Minister of West Bengal in Kolkata. **Naidu** congratulated the new government and expressed his best wishes for its success, while **Pawan Kalyan** highlighted the significance of the BJP's victory in addressing concerns about violence, lawlessness, and national security.

recent_articles.title: Pastor sexual assault case: Commission to visit house of the victim in Andhra Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Andhra Pradesh State Commission for Protection of Child Rights (APSCPCR)** has taken suo motu cognizance of the alleged sexual assault and abuse of a minor girl by Church Pastor Choutapalli Rambabu in Kamavarapukota mandal. The commission is investigating reports that the victim was administered excessive dosage of abortion pills, leading to severe health complications.  The incident has sparked widespread concern across the state.

recent_articles.title: 26-year-old Indian student dies of heart attack in US, a day after celebrating graduation walk - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mohammed Kumel Shaik**, a 26-year-old Indian student, died of cardiac arrest in California after celebrating his graduation from **Golden Gate University**.  His friends launched a fundraiser to help return his body to India for burial. The family is from a lower-middle-class background and the funds will also assist with educational loans and funeral expenses.

recent_articles.title: Census enumerators ID can be verified through QR code - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lalit Jain**, Director of Census Operations (DCO), **Haryana**, has introduced QR code-enabled identity cards for enumerators to address concerns about authenticity.  Jain explained that residents can verify the legitimacy of enumerators by scanning the codes on their ID cards. The first phase of the digital census, which began on April 1, aims to cover over 30 lakh households across India. Residents are legally obligated to answer Census-related questions, and while there have been no cases of FIRs for non-response, local authorities will be involved in encouraging participation.  The second phase of the census, focusing on caste enumeration, is scheduled for February 2027.

recent_articles.title: SC takes cognisance of resolution about HC judge sending advocate to custody - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** will hear a case on May 15th regarding an incident where an Andhra Pradesh High Court judge allegedly sent a young advocate to judicial custody for a procedural lapse. The **Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA)** and the **Bar Council of India (BCI)** have both expressed concern over the incident, urging the Chief Justice to intervene.

recent_articles.title: Nellore Rural MLA announces launch of 168 development works worth ₹17 crore on May 15 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nellore Rural MLA Kotamreddy Sridhar Reddy** announced the launch of 168 development works worth ₹17 crore in his constituency on May 15th.  The projects, supported by **Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu**, are part of a larger effort to improve infrastructure and services in the area. The event will feature foundation stone laying by local residents and participation from leaders of various political parties.

recent_articles.title: A.P. police registered 19,952 cases of crime against women in 2024, says NCRB report - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** police registered 19,952 cases of crime against women in 2024, a decrease from the previous years.  The **National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB)** reported that 17,149 individuals were arrested for these crimes and chargesheets were filed in 94.4% of the cases. The report highlighted various types of offenses, including harassment by husbands or relatives, sexual harassment, rape, attempted rape, stalking, kidnapping, assault, and murder.  A significant number of kidnapping cases remain pending with 865 cases unresolved at the end of 2024.

recent_articles.title: Faced harassment from a group of men onboard Delhi-bound flight, alleges MP Mahua Moitra - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mahua Moitra**, a Trinamool Congress MP, alleged she was harassed by a group of men on an **IndiGo** flight to Delhi.  She shared video evidence of the incident and tagged **Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu Kinjarapu** and **IndiGo** requesting action against those involved.  Moitra stated that she ignored the incident but later saw the video going viral and decided to publicly denounce it, adding she would file a formal complaint with the airline.

recent_articles.title: Gurugram gated societies not letting in enumerators; FIRs recommended against enumerators obstructing Census work - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Haryana** administration has recommended an FIR against two government school staff for alleged negligence in Census-related work and obstruction of duties.  **Gurugram Municipal Corporation Joint Commissioner Punit Kumar** stated that enumerators have been denied entry into several highrise apartment buildings, prompting him to write to RWAs to ensure their access. **Registrar General of India Mritunjay Kumar Narayan** flagged off awareness vans across Delhi for the ongoing Census 2027 public outreach campaign.  The first phase of the Census began on April 1 and will conclude by September 30, involving around 30 lakh enumerators.

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu directs officials to take a result-oriented approach, says A.P. inherited ₹9.74 lakh crore in debt - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** addressed the 7th Collectors’ Conference in Andhra Pradesh, emphasizing a welfare-driven governance model focused on development and wealth creation. He acknowledged the financial challenges inherited from the previous regime but highlighted the government's progress in welfare programs, infrastructure development, and economic growth. **Naidu** stressed the importance of effective grievance resolution, "zero-error" land records, and public satisfaction as key metrics for successful governance.  He directed officials to replicate successful models across districts, emphasizing the need for field visits by senior officers and Ministers to improve governance practices.

recent_articles.title: TDP whip cites YouTube documentary on red sanders smuggler to allege YSRCP-criminal links - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
**MLC Panchumarthi Anuradha** alleged that a YouTube documentary exposed the "criminal history" of **YSR Congress Party (YSRCP)** leaders, including associates of party president **Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy**.  She stated that the case of **Kollam Gangi Reddy**, a red sanders smuggler and a loyalist of former chief minister **Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy**, was revealed in the documentary, which also implicated him in the murder of **YS. Vivekananda Reddy**. 
**Ms. Anuradha** said this vindicated the **Telugu Desam Party's** claim that the YSRCP is filled with individuals connected to criminals.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader Varsha Gaikwad writes to Maharashtra Governor, seeks immediate enactment of Shakti Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Varsha Gaikwad**, **Mumbai Congress president** and MP, has written to **Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma** urging urgent action on rising crimes against women in the state.  Gaikwad requested the Governor's intervention regarding the **Shakti Criminal Laws (Maharashtra Amendment) Bill, 2020**, which awaits presidential assent, and urged the government to take strict action against atrocities against women. The letter comes amid protests following a four-year-old girl's alleged rape and murder in Pune district.

recent_articles.title: Andhra Pradesh SIPB clears investment proposals worth ₹2 lakh crore - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh**'s **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** presided over the 17th meeting of the State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB), approving investments worth over ₹2.01 lakh crore across various sectors.  **Reliance Industries**, **Adani Group**, and **Yamanko India Private Limited** received approvals for data centers, pumped storage hydro energy projects, and green hydrogen initiatives respectively. **Royal Enfield** will also establish a motorcycle manufacturing unit in Tirupati district, generating 3,000 jobs. The meeting emphasized the need for efficient project implementation and infrastructure development to attract further investment.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet panel clears Railway Ministry’s three multitracking projects in six States - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs**, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved three multitracking projects for the **Railway Ministry** with a total cost of ₹23,437 crore. These projects will increase the existing railway network by about 901 km in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. The projects are expected to be completed by 2030-31 and will enhance connectivity to approximately 4,161 villages, improve rail connectivity to several tourist destinations, and provide seamless connectivity for people, goods, and services.

recent_articles.title: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu unveils NABARD credit plan of ₹5.11 lakh crore for 2026–27 fiscal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. Chandrababu Naidu**, Chief Minister of **Andhra Pradesh**, unveiled a ₹5.11 lakh crore credit plan for the Financial Year 2026–27, representing a 20% increase from the previous year. The plan prioritizes agriculture and allied activities with allocations for crop loans, animal husbandry, farm mechanization, fisheries, horticulture, and agricultural infrastructure.  **NABARD** officials, including **M.R. Gopal**, Chief General Manager, and representatives from leading banks, attended the unveiling.

recent_articles.title: APSSDC partners with Japan’s FVCC to boost job opportunities for A.P. youth - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC)** and **Fourth Valley Concierge Corporation (FVCC), Japan**, have signed a Letter of Intent to facilitate overseas employment opportunities for Andhra Pradesh youth. The collaboration aims to create structured pathways for placements in Japan under visa categories such as Specified Skilled Workers (SSW) and the Engineer/Specialist in Humanities/International Services (EHI), with a focus on the automobile sector.  This partnership was signed by **APSSDC Executive Director D. Manohar** and **FVCC Executive Director Aki Takeda**.

recent_articles.title: POLYCET 2026: 91.37% pass in Andhra Pradesh; girls outdo boys, ASR district tops list - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A total of 1,48,950 candidates qualified for diploma courses in Andhra Pradesh after the **POLYCET** 2026 recorded a pass percentage of 91.37%.  The high turnout, exceeding 23,000 students compared to last year, saw girls outperform boys with a pass percentage of 93.57% against 89.88%. The **SBTET** attributed the strong performance to better access to technical education in remote areas.  **Nara Lokesh**, the Human Resource Development Minister, commended the students' success and encouraged those who did not qualify to remain determined.

recent_articles.title: New courts inaugurated across Visakhapatnam district - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Justice Ravi Nath Tilhari** and **Justice Ravi Cheemalapati**, of the **High Court of Andhra Pradesh**, inaugurated newly sanctioned courts in Visakhapatnam, Gajuwaka, Bheemunipatnam, and Narsipatnam on Sunday. The ceremonies were attended by senior judicial officers, bar association representatives, advocates, and police officials. These inaugurations are part of efforts to strengthen the judicial infrastructure of the district.

recent_articles.title: Naidu’s industrial push for Andhra Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nara Chandrababu Naidu**, the former Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, spearheaded efforts to establish Hyderabad as a major IT hub in the 1990s.  His initiative led to Microsoft establishing a global R&D center in the city in 1998, attracting other tech giants like Oracle, Google, Amazon, and Cognizant. This success has been a cornerstone of Naidu's political campaigns since then.

recent_articles.title: Jana Chaitanya Vedika urges Centre, State govt. to implement BC reservations in MLC, MP seats - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jana Chaitanya Vedika-AP State President Bankuru Joginaidu** urged **Union and State governments** to implement political reservations for backward classes in Parliament and Legislative Assemblies.  He presented a memorandum to **Vizianagaram MP Kalisetti Appala Naidu**, who promised to bring the issue to both governments' attention. **Naidu** also advocated extending reservation benefits to all 145 communities classified into five categories, arguing that only a few dominant communities currently benefit from these reservations in local body elections.

recent_articles.title: PD Act invoked against two bootleggers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. A. Siri**, **District Collector** of the district, issued Preventive Detention orders against two habitual Illicitly Distilled (ID) liquor offenders on Sunday, May 3, 2026. The orders were executed by inspectors from **Pathikonda** and **Kurnool Excise Stations**, with the accused lodged in the Central Prison for Men in Kadapa.  The **Excise Department** will provide alternative livelihood opportunities to those who have given up criminal activities through coordination with various government welfare departments.

recent_articles.title: TB dam crest gates repairs nearing completion, inauguration likely by May 15, says Shivakumar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister and Water Resources Minister of **Karnataka**, announced that the extensive repair and replacement of all 33 crest gates at the Tungabhadra Dam are nearing completion, with a target inauguration date set for May 15th.  The project, considered a technical marvel, has been completed ahead of schedule and will enhance the dam's lifespan by another 50 years. The state government is collaborating with **Andhra Pradesh** on the project, which aims to support agriculture in several regions across Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.

recent_articles.title: TDP MLC urges officials to join their children in government schools - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vepada Chiranjeevi Rao**, a Telugu Desam Party MLC, praised **Andhra Pradesh government schools'** performance in the recent SSC Class 10 Board exams.  He encouraged officials and employees to join their children in government schools, along with MLAs Aditi Vijaya Lakshmi and Gade Srinivasulu Naidu, who also felicitated students and teachers for achieving good results. Sixty students from six districts in North Andhra were promised financial assistance at the event.

recent_articles.title: SSC exams: apply for recounting, re-verification by May 7 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Andhra Pradesh Board of Secondary Education (APBSE**) has opened a window for online application forms for recounting and re-verification of answer scripts from May 1 to 7, 2026. Candidates must submit the forms through their school logins and pay a fee of ₹500 per subject for recounting or ₹1,000 per subject for re-verification. Payments can be made online via debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI, but not through CFMS Citizen Challan.

recent_articles.title: IMD forecasts more heatwaves in coastal Andhra Pradesh, warmer nights across State - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The India Meteorological Department (IMD)** predicts a higher number of heatwaves in coastal Andhra Pradesh this month, with above-normal minimum temperatures across the state.  **Rayalaseema** is expected to experience above-normal maximum temperatures with a 33.5% to 45% probability, while Central and North Andhra Pradesh may see normal to below-normal maximum temperatures. **The IMD-Amaravati Director S. Stella** cautioned that any dip in maximum temperatures would be marginal and confined to a few areas, emphasizing the peak summer phase is not over yet.

recent_articles.title: Aqua farmers in upbeat mood as India’s seafood exports cross ₹72,000-crore mark - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** aquaculture farmers are celebrating record-breaking seafood exports, exceeding ₹72,000 crore in the 2025-26 fiscal year.  Exports reached an all-time high, with **India** surpassing previous records and accounting for over 30% of the total volume. The export growth was driven by strong demand from markets like China, the European Union (EU), and Southeast Asia.  The Marine Products Export Development Authority (MPEDA) attributes this success to diversification efforts and a shift away from reliance on the United States.

recent_articles.title: Tele-MANAS helpline counselling 3,000 people per month in A.P., says Health Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** Minister for Health, Family Welfare and Medical Education Satya Kumar Yadav stated that the **Tele-MANAS** helpline, launched by the **Union government** in 2022 to address mental health issues, is providing support to individuals experiencing stress, depression, and anxiety. The national helpline, operated by **NIMHANS**, Bengaluru, routes calls to call centers within each state, with two centers in Andhra Pradesh located in Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.

recent_articles.title: Revenue Association urges govt. to appointment of new PRC - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B.V.V.N. Raju**, president of the **Andhra Pradesh Revenue Services Association**, and other officials met with **K. Atchannaidu**, Minister for Agriculture, to address concerns about workload and arrears owed to revenue staff. The group urged the government to appoint a new Pay Revision Commission and requested the minister to bring their grievances to **N Chandrababu Naidu**.  **Atchannaidu** assured that he would relay their petitions to the Chief Minister.

recent_articles.title: ₹1 lakh crore investment push for aerospace, defence section in Andhra Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Andhra Pradesh** government has approved the allocation of 350 acres for a defense manufacturing facility under the **DRDO**, signaling a major investment in the aerospace and defense sector. The project, expected to attract around ₹1 lakh crore from **DRDO**, aligns with the state's Aerospace and Defence Policy (4.0) which aims to establish Andhra Pradesh as a global hub for research, development, and manufacturing.  The policy also targets attracting investments of ₹1 lakh crore, generating employment for one lakh people, and developing MSME clusters under a hub-and-spoke model.

recent_articles.title: A.P. govt. will set up ‘Labour Addas’ to upskill workers, says CM Naidu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** announced plans to establish "labour addas" across the state, offering skill development hubs for workers and financial assistance programs.  The initiative includes new ESI hospitals in key industrial locations, along with revived financial assistance schemes for construction workers and pensions for over 6 million beneficiaries. **Naidu** also highlighted progress on infrastructure projects like the Polavaram Project.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu to witness hotter May; above normal rainfall could offer relief: IMD - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tamil Nadu** is expected to experience above-average temperatures in May, with coastal areas facing heatwave conditions and the mercury remaining high at night. The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** has issued an agromet advisory warning of potential agricultural impacts from the increased temperatures.  The IMD also predicts heavy rainfall in the Western Ghats and interior districts until Monday, May 4th, 2026, with some areas experiencing above-average rainfall due to convective activity. The state has already experienced a deficit in rainfall since March 1st, 2026, with only 41 mm recorded compared to the usual 66.3 mm for May.

recent_articles.title: India to tap augmented solar capacity, coal to weather El Nino, summer-related power demand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** is expected to meet its increased power demand this summer, with traditional coal-powered thermal plants and augmented solar power playing a key role.  While **India's** peak power demand reached 256.1 gigawatts in April, **thermal plants** accounted for 66.9% of generation, while solar power contributed 21.5%. Despite the potential impact of El Nino on monsoon rains and temperatures, **India** has ample coal reserves to meet its needs, with a stock sufficient for over 83 days of usage.  The government is confident in the country's ability to weather the challenges posed by both summer demand and El Nino conditions.

recent_articles.title: India to tap augmented solar capacity, coal to weather El Nino, summer-related power demand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** is expected to meet its increased power demands this summer, with traditional coal-powered thermal plants and augmented solar power playing a key role.  While solar energy accounts for about 30% of India's installed capacity, limitations in battery storage currently restrict its full utilization. **The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD)** predicts El Nino conditions that could lead to weaker monsoon rains and longer dry spells, impacting rainfall patterns across the country. However, **India** has ample coal stocks, with daily consumption averaging around 2.3-2.4 million tonnes, which would last for more than 83 days.

recent_articles.title: Census 2027: Around 82 lakh households have opted for self enumeration as field visits begin in 5 states - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Union government** announced that over 82 lakh households have utilized the self-enumeration facility during the initial Houselisting and Housing Operations (HLO) phase of Census 2027. The exercise, which commenced on May 1st in several states including Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Rajasthan, aims to collect data about household facilities and demographics.  The HLO will continue until May 30th, with trained enumerators visiting each house for verification.

recent_articles.title: Summer coaching camps begin across Vizag district - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The District Sports Authority of Visakhapatnam** launched 65 annual summer coaching camps across 28 sports disciplines in rural and urban centers, running until May 31. The initiative, organized by the **Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP)**, aims to introduce children aged 8-16 to structured training and promote a healthy lifestyle through regular sporting activity.  **District Sports Development Officer June Gallyot** emphasized the camps' importance in identifying talent, encouraging constructive summer use, and instilling discipline from a young age. The camps are being conducted across multiple centers with support from the **Department of Ayush**, providing necessary equipment and emergency medical support through nearby Primary Health Centres.

recent_articles.title: TDP leaders meet at Pemmasani’s house in Guntur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pemmasani Chandrasekhar**, Union Minister of State for Rural Development and Communications, hosted a dinner-cum-review meeting for public representatives from the Guntur Parliamentary constituency.  The gathering included **Nara Lokesh**, Andhra Pradesh Minister for Education and IT, along with several MLAs and party leaders. Discussions focused on strengthening the party organization, recent political developments, and development programs in the district.  **Lokesh** assured continued support to public representatives and promised assistance to those facing challenges.

recent_articles.title: Commercial LPG price hike is a blow to restaurants, say star hotel owners in A.P. - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh Star Hotels Association (ASHA)** members expressed concern over the recent surge in commercial LPG cylinder prices, which have increased by ₹993 since May 1st. **R. V. Swamy**, ASHA State president, stated that this hike has significantly impacted the hotel and restaurant industry, making daily operations unsustainable.  He also noted rising costs of essential commodities like edible oils and provisions, along with increased packaging material prices, leading to heavy losses for hotel owners. To mitigate these challenges, **ASHA** is urging customers to understand the situation and cooperate as they strive to maintain quality standards despite financial strain.

recent_articles.title: Artificial fuel shortage at 56 of 4,312 petrol bunks in Andhra Pradesh, says BJP state chief Madhav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.V.N. Madhav**, **BJP State president**, urged petrol bunks in **Andhra Pradesh** to ensure fuel availability, citing irregularities affecting 1.29% of outlets.  Following a week-long fuel disruption that caused long queues and shortages, **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** directed officials to increase supply by 10%, monitor stock levels through the Real Time Governance Centre, and address black-marketing. By April 29th, the situation had stabilized with sufficient stocks and reduced queues reported at most outlets.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader booked under POCSO - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anand Naidu**, general secretary of the **Bengaluru North District Congress Committee (DCC)**, has been booked by the Mahalakshmi Layout police for allegedly assaulting minor children.  The complaint alleges that Naidu was in an illicit relationship with the complainant's wife for three years and assaulted his children when they questioned the relationship. The children have accused Naidu of using a rod and biting them, causing injuries. The police have registered a case and initiated an investigation.

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation for Google’s ₹1.35 lakh crore AI data centre in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a 1-Gigawatt Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam, marking one of India's largest foreign direct investments. The project will be managed by **Google’s subsidiary Raiden Infotech**, in partnership with **Adani Infra**, and is part of a $15 billion investment from **Google** in the state.  The center will offer large-scale data storage and AI cloud infrastructure, and an upcoming subsea cable system will connect Visakhapatnam to several countries. Union Ministers, IT Minister Nara Lokesh, and representatives from Google, Adani Group, and Airtel Nxtra attended the ceremony.

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation for Google’s ₹1.35 lakh crore AI data centre in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: On Tuesday, April 28, 2026, **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam. The $15 billion investment will create a 1-Gigawatt hyperscale AI data center on 601.4 acres and is expected to generate thousands of jobs. **Union Ministers Ashwini Vaishnaw**, **Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu**, and **Pemmasani Chandrasekhar**, along with **IT Minister Nara Lokesh** and representatives from Google, Adani Infra, and other partners attended the ceremony.  The project will be inaugurated in September 2028 and is expected to position Andhra Pradesh as an international data gateway for India.

recent_articles.title: BJD asks Odisha Speaker to disqualify MLAs who cross-voted in Rajya Sabha election - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Biju Janata Dal (BJD)** has demanded the disqualification of eight Odisha MLAs who voted against the party's decision in the March 16 Rajya Sabha election. The BJD, citing the Tenth Schedule, argues that these MLAs violated party directives and should be disqualified for defying the whip.  The MLAs, however, maintain their actions were constitutional and claim the move is an attempt to pressure them into submission. **Surama Padhy**, the Odisha Assembly Speaker, is currently examining the BJD's formal complaint.

recent_articles.title: Naidu sets ₹4.60-a-unit power purchase target for Andhra Pradesh by year-end - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** directed officials to reduce the state's power purchase cost to ₹4.60 per unit by year-end and increase renewable energy generation.  He emphasized technology-driven reforms in the power sector, urging officials to study cost-effective methods globally and prioritize research and analysis within the department. **Naidu** also called for expanding renewable energy sources to over 50% of the state's power generation by 2028-29 and setting up a dedicated Energy University.  The meeting was attended by Energy Minister Gottipati Ravi Kumar and senior officials from various departments.

recent_articles.title: Fuel rush in parts of Hyderabad on April 27, dealers say adequate stocks available - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: On Monday, April 27, 2026, **Hyderabad** experienced a surge in demand for fuel at several petrol pumps, leading to long queues and temporary closures. The **Telangana Petroleum Dealers Association (TPDA)** attributed the disruption to a diesel supply issue rather than an overall shortage, stating that Sunday's lack of replenishment coincided with increased demand.  While some areas reported normal functioning, others experienced significant congestion due to limited fuel availability.

recent_articles.title: Andhra Pradesh fuel crisis: Naidu orders three-hourly reports; officials deny shortage - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** district authorities assured the public that there was no shortage of petrol or diesel in the state, urging against panic-buying and rumors circulating online.  The **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu**, following a review of 421 fuel outlets on Sunday, held another teleconference to address the situation. Despite this reassurance, queues remained at fuel stations throughout the day.

recent_articles.title: Trade deal with U.S. harming farmers’ interests, says AIKS leader - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ashok Dhawale**, president of **All India Kisan Sabha**, criticized trade agreements with the United States for harming Indian farmers, citing weakened domestic agriculture and rising input costs as contributing factors to a crisis.  He blamed flawed government policies and lack of effective land reforms for the situation, while demanding interest-free loans, implementation of the M.S. Swaminathan Commission recommendations, and support for tenant farmer families.

recent_articles.title: FAPTO hunger strike enters second day in Vijayawada - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **FAPTO** leaders, including chairman L. Sai Srinivas and secretary general S. Chiranjeevi, intensified their hunger strike in Vijayawada demanding immediate constitution of the 12th Pay Revision Commission (PRC), interim relief, unified service rules, compassionate appointments, and other issues.  The **Federation of Andhra Pradesh Teachers’ Organisations** submitted 17 demands to the government, with secretary general Chiranjeevi alleging that teachers were not being prioritized by the government. The hunger strike was supported by private schools and lecturers federation president D. Prasanna and leaders from various districts.

recent_articles.title: Trial run commences on section of Chittoor - Thatchur National Highway - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Chittoor - Thatchur National Highway**, a 92-kilometer stretch connecting Uthukottai and Chittoor in Andhra Pradesh, has been opened to vehicular traffic on a trial basis. The six-lane access controlled road will eventually connect to the new Bengaluru - Chennai Expressway by August.

recent_articles.title: Tent cities planned at 21 Godavari temples for Pushkarams, says Tourism Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Minister for Tourism and Culture Kandula Durgesh** announced plans to establish tent cities at 21 temples along the Godavari River in preparation for the 2027 **Godavari Pushkarams**. The largest tent city, located on Bridge Lanka island in Rajamahendravaram, is part of the ongoing **Godavari Riverfront Project**, and was approved by **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu**.

recent_articles.title: Children with Special Needs from State-run schools in Andhra Pradesh scale Everest Base Camp, set national benchmark - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Twenty-one children with special needs** from government schools in Andhra Pradesh successfully completed the Everest Base Camp trek in Nepal. The 16-day expedition, organized by **Samagra Shiksha**, Andhra Pradesh, and supported by the School Education Department, marked the first government-sponsored Everest Base Camp trek for specially-abled students.  The students, accompanied by mountaineers and officials, demonstrated their determination to overcome social stigma and achieve their goals. **Nara Lokesh**, HRD Minister and IT Minister of Andhra Pradesh, congratulated the students on their success and highlighted the importance of inclusivity in education.

recent_articles.title: Govt. to restore 10th century Siddheswara Swamy temple in Nellore district - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** Minister for Endowments, Anam Ramanarayana Reddy, visited the 10th century **Siddheswara Swamy temple** at Krishnapatnam Port area with officials from various states and the **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** to inspect its heritage status and discuss development plans. The visit included representatives from Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Telangana.

recent_articles.title: Hydrologist backs TUDA plan to revive Avilala tank on lines of Hyderabad’s Tank Bund - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arun Krishnamurthy**, founder of the **Environmentalist Foundation of India (EFI)**, endorsed the **Tirupati Urban Development Authority’s (TUDA)** plan to conserve and revive the Avilala tank.  The project, which will be executed by the **Water Resources Department** using TUDA funds, includes restoring the supply channel from Peruru tank to Avilala. The TUDA board, led by chairman **Divakar Reddy** and vice-chairman **R. Govindarao**, has approved the necessary sanctions for the work.

recent_articles.title: Artists get creative at ‘Articulate Gunturian’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vellaturi Krishna Prasad**, a painter from Guntur, organized an art exhibition in the city showcasing nearly 300 paintings by artists of various ages and styles. The "Articulate Gunturian" program featured works using diverse mediums like wax crayons, oil pastels, watercolors, and acrylics, reflecting themes including Andhra Pradesh's cultural heritage, women's safety, and wildlife protection.  **N. V. Sundarachary**, Principal of **Guntur Medical College**, and **Nannapaneni Rajakumari** attended the event, encouraging the artists.

recent_articles.title: 13 special courts proposed to fast-track narcotics cases in A.P., says DGP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Director General of Police (DGP) Harish Kumar Gupta** announced plans to establish 13 special courts in Andhra Pradesh to expedite the trial of narcotics-related cases.  Gupta stated that nearly 7,000 drug-related cases are pending in courts across the state. To combat drug use and consumption, **the government** will supply 10,000 drug testing kits to police in the first phase. The initiative is being spearheaded by the **Elite Anti-Narcotics Group for Law Enforcement (EAGLE)**.

recent_articles.title: Lisa Gill takes charge as Chief Justice of A.P. High Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Justice Lisa Gill** was sworn in as the Chief Justice of the **Andhra Pradesh High Court** by Governor **S. Abdul Nazeer**. The ceremony took place at Lok Bhavan, with **G. Sai Prasad**, **G. Anantha Ramu**, and other dignitaries present.  **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** also extended his well wishes to Justice Gill.

recent_articles.title: A.B. Venkateswara Rao issues legal notices to retired and serving IPS officers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Retired IPS officer **A.B. Venkateswara Rao** has filed legal notices against several individuals and organizations, including former DGPs, a CID director, and the State of Andhra Pradesh, seeking damages totaling ₹1 crore for alleged malicious prosecution, unlawful suspension, fabrication of records, defamation, and violation of his constitutional rights.  He claims he was falsely implicated in a case concerning procurement of security equipment and alleges that the High Court's quashing of the FIR and charge-sheet proves the malicious nature of the prosecution against him.

recent_articles.title: APPGECET to be held from April 28 to 30 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)** has prepared for the **APPGECET-2026**, scheduled to be held from April 28th to 30th across the state. The exam will be conducted in a Computer-Based Test (CBT) format with two sessions, from 9 a.m. to 11 noon and 2 p.m. to 4 p.m., at 26 examination centers in 18 towns.  Candidates must arrive early, adhere to instructions, and bring only their hall ticket, application form, valid ID, and ballpoint pen. Electronic gadgets are prohibited.

recent_articles.title: Shuttered filling stations, restricted sales fuel anxiety in Andhra Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** is experiencing a sudden fuel shortage of both petrol and diesel, leaving many retail outlets dry. **The State government**, **oil marketing companies**, and **IndianOil** have assured the public that there is sufficient stock to last for the next 15 days. However, commuters, farmers, aqua farmers, and transport operators are facing difficulties due to long queues at limited functional filling stations.  Despite assurances from oil companies, the disconnect between port logistics and retail outlets continues to leave citizens waiting in line.
